protocol_lineage: ElectionGuard Design Specification v2.1.0, section 3.1.1 'Standard Baseline Cryptographic Parameters'
subgroup_relation: p = q * r + 1; ord(g) = q; g^q mod p = 1

derivation.note: The entire parameter set is reconstructible offline from the published structural rule plus one recorded constant. This is stronger than any URL: it does not say where the bytes came from, it says the bytes are the ones the published rule produces. A transcription error anywhere in p, q, g or r fails reconstruction.
derivation.p_structure: p = ONES(256) || M(3584) || ONES(256), 4096 bits total
derivation.p_middle_rule: M = (first 3305 fractional bits of ln 2) << 279 | delta_low_279. The ln 2 bits are computed locally as 2*atanh(1/3) = 2*sum_{k>=0} (1/3)^(2k+1)/(2k+1); no table and no network are used.

corroborating.human_readable_url_note: a /main/ reference is mutable and is recorded for a human reader only; it is never the reference a verifier should rely on
corroborating.source_sha256_verification_scope: Obtained on a network-enabled host and supplied to the build session, which has no route to github.com. This session verified the recorded values for internal consistency (40-character lower-case object id; the pinned URL contains that exact commit and that exact file path; the digest is 64 lower-case hex characters) and re-verified every parameter value by offline reconstruction, but it did NOT re-fetch the upstream bytes and therefore does not independently attest source_sha256. An auditor closes that last gap in one command: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/electionguard-rust/520651138110a13f777409e96606454df928ceac/src/eg/src/standard_parameters.rs | sha256sum
corroborating.provenance_status: SATISFIED - normative specification pinned to a versioned release asset with its digest recorded here, and the corroborating implementation source pinned to an immutable commit with its raw-byte digest recorded here. The two are recorded separately and neither stands in for the other.
corroborating.withdrawn_digest_note: A source_sha256 recorded by an earlier round (3afa2962...12ce) was computed over a markdown rendering of this file rather than its raw bytes. It was WITHDRAWN rather than relabelled and is NOT restored here. A digest over the wrong bytes is worse than no digest: a reader will check it, find a mismatch, and have no way to tell which artefact is wrong.
corroborating.role: corroborating implementation source only; it is NOT a substitute for the normative specification and is not authoritative for any value here

digests.note: Two different things, deliberately named differently. `parameter_digest` is over the local canonical parameter tuple; a `source_sha256` would be over an upstream file's exact bytes. They answer different questions and must never be confused for one another.
